title: tld connectors.yaml
description: Workspace connector (edge) definitions for the tld / tlDiagram CLI. The file is a list of connectors. Each connector lives in a view and links a source element to a target element. `view`, `source`, and `target` are required and are validated against elements.yaml by `tld validate`.

elementRef.description: Element reference matching a key in elements.yaml. Must start with a lowercase letter or digit and may contain lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores, and hyphens. `root` is reserved and cannot be used here.

viewRef.description: View reference: either `root` for the top-level workspace view or the ref of an element that owns a child view (has_view: true).

connector.description: A directed edge between two elements within a view.

source.description: Source element ref (tail of the edge).

target.description: Target element ref (head of the edge).

label.description: Short text shown on the edge (e.g. action or payload name).

description.description: Longer explanation of what flows across the connector.

relationship.description: Relationship/protocol category (e.g. SQL, HTTP, gRPC, pub/sub). Free-form; used for grouping and styling.

direction.description: Edge direction. Defaults to `forward` when omitted. `none` renders an undirected line.

style.description: Edge routing style. Defaults to `bezier` when omitted.

url.description: External link for the connector (e.g. a runbook or API docs).

source_handle.description: Anchor on the source node the edge attaches to.

target_handle.description: Anchor on the target node the edge attaches to.

tags.description: Free-form labels used for filtering and visual grouping.

visibility_delta.description: Density/noise-gate adjustment applied to this connector relative to its view.

id.description: Server-assigned resource id encoded as a Hashid. Managed by the CLI/server; safe to omit when hand-authoring. Present only when synced with a server.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last server update. Usually tracked in .tld.lock instead of inline.
